title: Circular Connectors for Radio and Associated Sound Equipment for Frequencies Below 3 MHz Including DC, Part 9: Fixed Seven-Socket Connector for Microphone with Remote Control Type 11777 IS-08
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11777 (PART 9)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Circular Connectors for Radio and Associated Sound Equipment for Frequencies Below 3 MHz Including DC, Part 9: Fixed Seven-Socket Connector for Microphone with Remote Control Type 11777 IS-08.
clause_3_terminology: Circular Connectors for Radio and Associated Sound Equipment for Frequencies Below 3 MHz Including DC
Socket Connector for Microphone with Remote Control Type 11777 IS

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
